title: Your Stomach Acid Can Eat Through a Razor Blade

scenes.text: Your stomach acid is strong enough to eat through a razor blade.
Doctors actually tested this. In nineteen ninety-seven they dropped razor blades into artificial stomach acid.
Within two hours, the thick back edge of a blade had dissolved completely. After a day, more than a third of the blade was gone.
Your stomach acid has a pH of around one and a half to three and a half. Strong enough to corrode steel.
It does not eat you because your stomach lining sacrifices itself, shedding cells so fast that the whole surface is replaced about every three days.
Coins, by the way, came out of the acid untouched. So please never test this. Which body fact surprises you most?

description:
Your stomach acid is strong enough to corrode a razor blade.
In a 1997 study published in Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, doctors placed razor blades in simulated gastric juice. The thick back of a single-edged blade dissolved within two hours, and after 24 hours the blades had lost more than a third of their weight. Coins were unaffected.
Stomach acid has a pH of about 1.5 to 3.5; your stomach lining survives by shedding cells so fast that its surface is replaced about every three days.
Never swallow metal objects. Which body fact surprises you most?
